scope: Directed primary-source comparison of all 12 manuscript references; no exhaustive novelty or priority certification. Extracting full PDFs is not claiming full reading.

references.title: Holevo, Entanglement-breaking channels in infinite dimensions
references.actual_reading_depth: Physical pages 11-12: Theorem 2 statement, characteristic-function sufficiency and continuation of necessity proof. Complete paper not read.
references.use_and_limits: Known measure-prepare structure. Specialized identity independently checked in manuscript conventions; general infinite-dimensional theorem not fully reproved.

references.title: Holevo and Giovannetti, Quantum channels and their entropic characteristics
references.actual_reading_depth: Physical pages 25-26, 33 and 44-46; Sections 3.4-3.5, selected 4.3 and historical capacity discussion.
references.use_and_limits: Gaussian EB threshold and one-component classical limit are prior. Historical open questions not treated as current.

references.title: Csiszar, The Method of Types
references.version: IEEE TIT 44 (1998), 2505-2523; DOI 10.1109/18.720546; original article PDF on academic mirror
references.actual_reading_depth: Text pages 1-4; formulas visually read on physical pages 2-3, 5-7. Section II counts; Section IV Lemma IV.1, Theorem IV.1 and proof. Appendix proof of packing lemma not reread.
references.use_and_limits: Type counts and universal empirical decoder are established. Current manuscript supplies its own threshold/net argument.

references.title: Bjelakovic and Boche, Classical Capacities of Compound and Averaged Quantum Channels
references.actual_reading_depth: Reused unchanged primary PDF, newly read physical pages 2-3, classical Section II and initial quantum definitions/theorem. Not a new complete reading.
references.use_and_limits: Finite classical sup-inf/common code formulation; not direct justification for continuous output or full quantum theorem.

references.title: Mitran, Devroye and Tarokh, On Compound Channels with Side-Information at the Transmitter
references.version: Author draft dated 20 December 2005; distinct from published IEEE TIT 52 (2006), 1745-1755
references.actual_reading_depth: Physical pages 3 and 10-13: receiver CSI assumption, common quantizers, Lemmas 3-5 and displayed proof steps. Appendix of Lemma 4 not newly read.
references.use_and_limits: Dini/common quantization antecedent; operational theorem with receiver CSI is not imported for no-CSI decoder.

references.title: Schaefer and Loyka, The Secrecy Capacity of Compound Gaussian MIMO Wiretap Channels
references.actual_reading_depth: Physical pages 3-7: model without full receiver CSI, finite approximation and Section III common quantization statements and proof references.
references.use_and_limits: Prior uniform quantization/net mechanisms. No secrecy capacity or Gaussian MIMO optimizer imported; full proof not reaudited.

references.title: Tu, Li and Dhillon, An information-theoretic framework for vision-aided communication over memoryless on-off fading channels
references.version: npj Wireless Technology 2, 80; published 1 October 2026; DOI 10.1038/s44459-026-00074-7
references.actual_reading_depth: Primary publisher text supplied by web search: abstract/model, Gaussian section, Theorem 1 and presented proof, Theorem 2 and proof referral, neighboring discussion. Not complete article PDF.
references.use_and_limits: Real on/off model with equal branch noise, prior non-Gaussian motivation. Theorem 2 defers proof and is not independently certified or used to prove current theorem.

references.title: Catalano, Fanizza, Mele, De Palma and Giovannetti, Convex combinations of bosonic pure-loss channels
references.actual_reading_depth: Reused unchanged primary PDF. Newly read physical pages 10-12 before audit reports, then pages 35-37 Appendix E after reports.
references.use_and_limits: Direct methodological precedent for rotational symmetry, strict concavity/injection and strict growth; different EA functional and vacuum reset. No numerical or full Appendix C audit.

references.title: Weedbrook et al., Gaussian Quantum Information
references.actual_reading_depth: Physical pages 11-12, II.E and II.E.2. Adjacent entanglement material seen incidentally.
references.use_and_limits: Gaussian measurement outcome and heterodyne facts; photon +1 checked directly, not transferred uncritically between quadrature conventions.

references.title: Huber and Koenig, Coherent state coding approaches the capacity of non-Gaussian bosonic channels
references.actual_reading_depth: Physical pages 7-9, 11-12; Theorem 1, model/scope, selected proof Eqs 24-29 and surrounding bounds. Imported EPIs not reproved.
references.use_and_limits: Prior coherent near-optimality with environment-dependent energy-independent bound at fixed channel; not current joint-scaling compound result.

references.title: Adesso, Lami and Giovannetti, Classical capacity of single-mode bosonic Gaussian channels
references.actual_reading_depth: Physical pages 4-5: preceding entropy argument and Section IV Theorem 2, proof and Corollary 3. Underlying Theorem 1/Appendices not completely audited.
references.use_and_limits: Gaussian-channel scope checked; generic mixtures not covered, fixed-error formula not imported.

references.title: Holevo, On the Classical Capacity of General Quantum Gaussian Measurement
references.version: Entropy 23 (2021), 377, DOI 10.3390/e23030377; preprints 2101.00423v2 and v3 are different artifacts
references.actual_reading_depth: Preprint v2 physical pages 1-9; v3 page 9; published Remark 2 specifically read through primary MDPI indexed text. The published Remark 2 is absent as such in those preprints.
references.use_and_limits: Average Gaussian state versus Gaussian ensemble distinction is prior; no Gaussian-measurement optimality theorem applied to this non-Gaussian channel. CLT dependency not independently reproved.

non_source_response_explanation: 3038-byte browser-check response, identical to failed PDF retrieval. Not article evidence. Primary article passage evidence is the separately archived web-tool rendering.
version_caution: Preprint versions are retained with their exact bytes; publisher Remark 2 checked separately. Current retrieved arXiv PDF cover-generation dates need not equal submission dates.
